HERO_WORKSHOP.NoHdc: {name} has no Hero Designer data yet. Upload an HDC file with the system's Upload button first.
HERO_WORKSHOP.NotOwner: You need owner permission on {name} to edit it.
HERO_WORKSHOP.NotAFamily: This folder isn't a Hero Designer list or framework. Right-click an item in it to edit that item.
HERO_WORKSHOP.TokenActor: Hero Workshop edits the base actor. Open {name} from the Actors sidebar to edit it.
HERO_WORKSHOP.ApplyFailed: Hero Workshop could not update {name}. The actor was not changed; see the console for details.
HERO_WORKSHOP.ItemNotEditable: Hero Workshop cannot edit {name} (no Hero Designer data for this item type).
HERO_WORKSHOP.RaceLibraryHint: Races and their listed characteristics, used to derive each character's characteristic maxima.
HERO_WORKSHOP.CurrenciesHint: The money in this game (coins, dollars...), each kept as a piece of equipment whose quantity is how many a character has. Item Piles uses them as its currencies.
HERO_WORKSHOP.NoSection: Hero Workshop can't add {name} to a character.
HERO_WORKSHOP.OpenItemsInWorkshopHint: Opening an item in the Items sidebar or a compendium edits it in Hero Workshop instead of showing hero6e's item sheet (which is still in the item's right-click menu). Items on characters, and items you can't edit, still open hero6e's sheet.
HERO_WORKSHOP.RepairImportsHint: When hero6e imports an HDC or HDP, link Combat Skill Levels to the attacks they name, comma-separate adjustment targets, and make other fixes hero6e needs. The build is not changed.
HERO_WORKSHOP.KillingStun: Killing attacks: STUN from BODY that gets through (house rule)
HERO_WORKSHOP.KillingStunHint: BODY is reduced by resistant defense as normal. The STUN multiplier is then applied to the BODY that got through, and only the non-resistant PD/ED is subtracted from that STUN. Applies when Apply Damage is used on a killing attack; BODY and knockback are hero6e's.
HERO_WORKSHOP.KillingStunMultiplierHint: Used by the killing STUN house rule. Increased/Decreased STUN Multiplier levels on the attack are added to a roll or fixed value.
HERO_WORKSHOP.KillingStunMultiplierHero6e: As hero6e (hit location STUNx; rolled when hit locations are off)
HERO_WORKSHOP.KillingStunMultiplierLocationOrFixed: Hit location STUNx; fixed value when hit locations are off
HERO_WORKSHOP.KillingStunMultiplierRolled: Always roll (hero6e's STUN multiplier dice, 1d3 by default)
HERO_WORKSHOP.KillingStunFixedHint: The multiplier when the STUN multiplier is set to Fixed value, or to hit location STUNx when hit locations are off. x2 is the average of the standard 1d3.
HERO_WORKSHOP.KillingStunBonusHint: Added to every killing attack's STUN multiplier under the house rule, to offset the resistant defense it now subtracts before multiplying.
HERO_WORKSHOP.KillingStunIncludesBodyMultiplier: Killing attacks: STUN multiplier includes location BODY multiplier
HERO_WORKSHOP.KillingStunIncludesBodyMultiplierHint: Under the killing STUN house rule with hit locations, multiply the BODY that got through by the location's BODY multiplier (Head and Vitals x2, limbs x1/2) before the STUN multiplier. Off: the STUN multiplier applies to the BODY that got through. BODY taken uses the location BODY multiplier either way. Leaving it out averages about 0.4 less STUN multiplier.
HERO_WORKSHOP.ImportRepaired: Hero Workshop repaired {changes} thing(s) in {name} for hero6e; {unresolved} couldn't be repaired automatically. Details are in the console (F12).
